description: This file defines an Android Activity class 'BrokenKeyDerivationActivity' which demonstrates handling insecure and secure key derivation for data encryption, decryption, and re-encryption processes. It includes methods for deriving keys, encrypting/decrypting data, and mock implementations for data persistence. The purpose appears to be educational or diagnostic regarding cryptographic practices in Android apps.

classes.name: BrokenKeyDerivationActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating key derivation, encryption, and re-encryption, highlighting insecure and secure practices with mock storage.

methods.name: deriveKeyInsecurely
methods.description: Derives an insecure AES key using a mock SHA1PRNG emulation from a password.

methods.name: deriveKeySecurely
methods.description: Derives a secure AES key using PBKDF2 with HMACSHA1 from a password.

methods.name: retrieveData
methods.description: Retrieves encrypted data, detects if stored with insecure key, and re-encrypts with secure key if needed.

methods.name: encryptOrDecrypt
methods.description: Performs AES encryption or decryption with CBC mode.

methods.name: cleanRoomStart
methods.description: Resets mock files and initializes mock encrypted data for consistent behavior.

methods.name: isDataStoredWithInsecureKey
methods.description: Checks if data is stored with an insecure key based on file existence.

methods.name: retrieveIv
methods.description: Retrieves or generates an IV for encryption.

methods.name: retrieveSalt
methods.description: Retrieves or generates a salt for key derivation.

methods.name: storeDataEncryptedWithSecureKey
methods.description: Stores encrypted data and marks it as securely encrypted.

methods.name: readFromFileOrCreateRandom
methods.description: Reads bytes from a file or creates random bytes if file does not exist.

methods.name: fileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists in the app's internal storage.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Deletes a specified file from internal storage.

methods.name: writeToFile
methods.description: Writes bytes to a specified file.

methods.name: readBytesFromFile
methods.description: Reads bytes from a specified file.
